storyTemplate.title: After Hours at Orison Station
storyTemplate.description: A focused mystery about an overnight station clerk, impossible tickets, hidden platforms, and trains that arrive from places the city insists do not exist.

story_source.title: After Hours at Orison Station
story_source.description: Original mystery story about impossible train routes, hidden platforms, and erased station records.

scene.summary: The night clerk is at the Orison Station desk after the last scheduled train when an impossible ticket prints.

player.name: Mara Elloway
player.personality_description: A practical city transit worker with steady nerves, quiet curiosity, and a habit of solving problems before asking permission. She is observant, kind to stranded people, and stubborn when records stop matching reality.
player.speech_style: Plainspoken and calm, with dry humor when pressure rises.

clothing.shirt: navy station uniform blouse with brass buttons

durable_known_facts: This is one of three selectable player characters for the story.
Mara works the quiet overnight shift at Orison Station.
She knows the normal platform schedule, ticket ledger, announcement booth, lost-property room, and signal access rules.
She is not a police officer and has limited authority outside the station.
She notices small discrepancies in records, timestamps, and passenger behavior.
She starts with a station key ring, a pocket radio, a ledger pencil, and enough confidence to question an impossible ticket.
Her choices can make her more official, more secretive, or more protective of stranded passengers.

players.speech_style: Soft-spoken and precise, with clipped questions and understated humor.

clothing.shirt: navy station uniform shirt with brass buttons

Riley works the quiet overnight shift at Orison Station.
They know the ticket printer, announcement booth, lost-property logs, and the small access rules most passengers never notice.
They are not a police officer and need evidence before anyone important will listen.
They are good at noticing when a familiar place has one extra door, one wrong sound, or one impossible timestamp.
They start with a station key ring, a pocket radio, a ledger pencil, and a habit of writing down contradictions.

clothing.shirt: navy station uniform shirt with brass buttons

Veda Coll.name: Veda Coll
Veda Coll.personality_description: A tired but sharp dispatcher who knows more station history than she likes admitting. She acts skeptical until evidence is undeniable, then becomes intensely protective of the staff.
Veda Coll.speech_style: Blunt, clipped, and practical, often answering with station jargon before translating herself.
durable_known_facts: Veda is the last day-shift employee leaving when the story begins.
She has heard rumors of old route numbers being erased from station records.
She dislikes panic and will demand proof before accepting impossible claims.
She can help interpret dispatch logs, staff memories, and old transit protocols.
If trusted, she becomes Mara's safest living witness before dawn.

world_flags.tone: quiet, grounded urban mystery with escalating impossible evidence
world_flags.setting_rule: The station is modern and non-magical on the surface; impossible events should feel like evidence to investigate, not fantasy spectacle.

items.title: Check the Unlisted Ticket
items.summary: A ticket has printed for a platform Orison Station does not have.

rewards.text: A physical ticket from the Neverline exists and should be treated as durable evidence.

rewards.title: Impossible Ticket
rewards.prompt: modern city train station night desk after hours, old ticket printer on a counter, single blue train ticket reading Platform Four and Neverline, open paper ledger, quiet fluorescent station lighting, grounded mystery atmosphere, no people
rewards.negative_prompt: text errors, watermark, logo, signature, extra people

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player examines the strange ticket, checks its route, or clearly starts investigating why it printed.
items.completion_instruction: Show that the ticket names Platform Four and a route called the Neverline, then make the next concrete action finding where the platform announcement came from.

items.title: Find Platform Four
items.summary: The announcement claims a train is boarding from a platform that should not exist.

rewards.title: Platform Four
rewards.prompt: hidden train platform inside a modern city station at night, blue Platform Four sign, empty tracks, dim service stair behind a wall, damp concrete, realistic urban mystery lighting, no people
rewards.negative_prompt: watermark, logo, signature, readable random text, crowd

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player goes to the platform area, checks the stairwells, or otherwise searches for the source of Platform Four.
items.completion_instruction: Reveal a service stair that was not on the normal station map and lead the player to an unused platform sign marked Four.

items.title: Inspect the Impossible Platform
items.summary: The hidden platform is real enough to stand on, but its signs do not match the station.

rewards.reason: Ira Noll is waiting on Platform Four with an impossible return ticket.

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player inspects Platform Four's sign, tracks, timetable board, or arrival markings.
items.completion_instruction: Let the platform feel physically real and reveal Ira Noll as the first stranded passenger without explaining the whole mystery.

items.title: Question Ira Noll
items.summary: The stranded passenger may know where the impossible route began.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player asks Ira where he came from, checks his ticket, or gets his account of the missing station.
items.completion_instruction: Have Ira describe buying coffee at a station no city map contains, then make the report-or-hide decision feel immediate.

items.title: Decide What to Do With the First Report
items.summary: Choose whether to make the incident official now or keep investigating quietly.
items.completion_criteria: Completed immediately by EmberAdventures when the player selects one option from the choice menu.
items.completion_instruction: Resolve only the selected reporting stance and return to the ledger investigation.

rewards.text: The player filed an official report about the impossible ticket and Platform Four.

choices.title: Keep It Off the Books For Now

rewards.text: The player chose to investigate the first impossible-ticket incident quietly before involving outside authorities.

items.title: Compare the Ticket Ledger
items.summary: The normal station records may reveal whether this happened before.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player checks the ticket ledger, terminal records, cash drawer logs, or old route sheets for matching anomalies.
items.completion_instruction: Reveal that several ordinary tickets were overwritten after midnight with route numbers that should not exist.

items.title: Trace the Announcement Wire
items.summary: The platform call used the station speaker system, but no one made it from the booth.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player checks the announcement booth, wiring closet, radio logs, or speaker controls.
items.completion_instruction: Show the announcement signal coming from the old signal room instead of the public booth, and unlock the signal room as the next place to inspect.

items.title: Inspect the Signal Room
items.summary: The old signal room may explain why the station called a train no one scheduled.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player enters or examines the old signal room and checks the active indicator board.
items.completion_instruction: Reveal a blue track light pulsing for the 1:13 train and make Ira's fear of boarding or missing it part of the scene.

items.title: Keep Ira Calm
items.summary: Ira may panic when the board announces another impossible arrival.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player reassures Ira, sets a boundary, asks him to stay put, or otherwise prevents him from bolting blindly.
items.completion_instruction: Let Ira respond to how the player handles him, then bring the 1:13 train into the station.

items.title: Let the 1:13 Arrive
items.summary: The hidden platform is calling in a train that should not be on the schedule.

rewards.reason: Len Talver steps off the 1:13 train with a stopped watch.

rewards.title: The 1:13 Train
rewards.prompt: driverless late-night train arriving at a hidden city station platform, blue destination light, doors opening into misty fluorescent darkness, grounded supernatural mystery, cinematic but realistic, no readable text
rewards.negative_prompt: watermark, logo, signature, fantasy castle, spaceship

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the narrator has shown the 1:13 train arriving, stopping, and opening its doors or passing through in a resolved way.
items.completion_instruction: Have the train arrive without a driver visible and introduce Len Talver as a passenger stepping off with a stopped watch.

items.title: Examine Len's Watch
items.summary: Len carries a watch that stopped at a time the station has not reached yet.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player asks about Len's watch, inspects it, compares it to station time, or questions Len's delivery route.
items.completion_instruction: Reveal that Len's watch stopped at 3:17 and that their delivery address is missing from current maps.

items.title: Decide Whether Len Boards Again
items.summary: Len wants to board the next impossible train before the station takes notice.
items.completion_criteria: Completed immediately by EmberAdventures when the player selects one option from the choice menu.
items.completion_instruction: Resolve whether Len stays under protest or boards with a recorded warning, then continue toward the lost-property search.

rewards.text: Len was prevented from boarding another impossible train and remains available as a reluctant witness.

choices.title: Let Len Board With a Warning

rewards.text: Len was allowed to board after the player warned them and recorded what happened.

items.title: Search Lost Property
items.summary: Objects left behind may prove the impossible route has been taking passengers for years.

rewards.reason: Mira Sorn arrives because the lost-property search disturbed evidence she has been watching.

rewards.title: Lost Property Room
rewards.prompt: cramped train station lost-property room at night, shelves of old coats bags umbrellas and tagged belongings, repeating date tags, dusty evidence boxes, single desk lamp, grounded mystery atmosphere, no people
rewards.negative_prompt: watermark, logo, signature, readable random text

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player searches the lost-property room, checks tagged items, or compares old belongings to the impossible route clues.
items.completion_instruction: Reveal a shelf of belongings tagged with dates that repeat every few years, then introduce Mira Sorn as someone who came for one of them.

items.title: Question Mira Sorn
items.summary: The woman in the raincoat knows enough to be useful and enough to be dangerous.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player asks Mira what she knows, challenges why she came, or gets her explanation of the old route map.
items.completion_instruction: Let Mira reveal that the Neverline follows stations erased by disasters, scandals, or deliberate coverups, but keep her motives uncertain.

items.title: Decide Whether to Trust Mira
items.summary: Mira can guide the investigation, but trusting her may shape who controls the truth.
items.completion_criteria: Completed immediately by EmberAdventures when the player selects one option from the choice menu.
items.completion_instruction: Resolve the player's stance toward Mira without revealing all of her motives, then move to the maintenance-door investigation.

rewards.text: The player shared key ledger evidence with Mira Sorn.
The player withheld the ledger from Mira Sorn and kept control of the evidence.

items.title: Open the Maintenance Door
items.summary: The old map points to a service door behind the platform wall.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player uses station keys, Mira's map, or evidence from the signal room to open or inspect the old maintenance door.
items.completion_instruction: Unlock the maintenance passage and reveal that the Neverline is connected to a buried part of the station, not another city.

items.title: Walk the Buried Passage
items.summary: The maintenance passage descends toward a part of Orison Station that should have been sealed.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player enters the maintenance passage, follows the old rail marks, or reaches the sealed lower concourse.
items.completion_instruction: Show the lower concourse as a real abandoned station layer with old public notices and fresh footprints.

items.title: Read the Erased Notices
items.summary: Old public notices may explain why a whole station layer vanished from records.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player reads, photographs, copies, or compares the old notices and erased station records.
items.completion_instruction: Reveal that the lower station was closed after a crowd disappeared during an overnight service and the public record was altered.

items.title: Interview Veda Before Dawn
items.summary: Veda's memory of old dispatch rules may connect the lower station to the current night shift.
items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player calls, wakes, meets, or questions Veda about old dispatch records and the missing lower station.
items.completion_instruction: Have Veda confirm that older staff were told never to acknowledge Platform Four, then let her become a reliable witness if treated honestly.

items.title: Assemble the Route Pattern
items.summary: The ticket, watch, ledger, lost property, and old notices point to one rule.

rewards.text: The player has identified the Neverline pattern: it appears around erased returns and unresolved station disappearances.

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player lays out the evidence, states a working theory, or compares enough clues to identify how the Neverline chooses arrivals.
items.completion_instruction: Let the player identify that the Neverline appears when the station hides a passenger's unfinished return, and make the next step deciding who hears the truth.

items.title: Choose Who Hears the Truth
items.summary: The evidence can protect people, expose the station, or disappear again.
items.completion_criteria: Completed immediately by EmberAdventures when the player selects one option from the choice menu.
items.completion_instruction: Record who the player chooses to tell before the final ride without fully resolving the ending yet.

rewards.text: The player sent the Neverline evidence to transit authority channels.
The player chose to tell stranded passengers the truth before involving institutions.

choices.title: Keep It Quiet Until Final Proof

rewards.text: The player kept the full Neverline theory quiet until one final proof could be gathered.

items.title: Ride to the Missing Stop
items.summary: The only way to prove the rule is to board the impossible train and see where it stops.

rewards.title: The Missing Stop
rewards.prompt: abandoned underground train stop hidden beneath a modern city station, old tile walls, blue route light, empty platform, evidence of passengers who waited too long, eerie grounded mystery mood, no monsters, no people
rewards.negative_prompt: watermark, logo, signature, gore, fantasy portal

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the player boards the Neverline train, follows it to the missing stop, or otherwise commits to the final proof ride.
items.completion_instruction: Take the player to the missing stop without making the ride feel like a random dream; tie every detail to earlier clues.

items.title: Solve Orison Station's Rule
items.summary: The missing stop reveals why some passengers return and others are erased.

rewards.text: The player knows Orison Station's rule: erased passengers can return only when their journey is witnessed and recorded honestly.

items.completion_criteria: Return yes only when the narrator has shown the missing stop's core rule and how the player's evidence explains the Neverline's appearances.
items.completion_instruction: Reveal that the station preserves unfinished returns until someone witnesses them honestly; then push toward the final decision about the schedule.

items.title: Decide the Final Schedule
items.summary: Choose what Orison Station becomes after the truth is known.
items.completion_criteria: Completed immediately by EmberAdventures when the player selects one option from the choice menu.
items.completion_instruction: Resolve the chosen ending clearly and leave the result playable as an epilogue state rather than a vague cliffhanger.

rewards.text: Ending path: the player sealed Platform Four after recording the truth, preventing new impossible arrivals at Orison Station.
Ending path: the player kept a controlled watched return route so erased passengers can be witnessed home.
Ending path: the player published the full Neverline record, forcing the city to confront what it erased.

durable_known_facts: Ira appears after Platform Four is first discovered.
His ticket names a return route that no active schedule contains.
He remembers a station bell ringing under a street with no name.
He is not dangerous, but fear can make him try to board the next impossible train.
His memories are the first proof that passengers can return changed but alive.

clothing.other_accessory: paper coffee cup with no shop logo

len_talver.name: Len Talver
len_talver.meet_condition: Introduced when the 1:13 impossible train arrives.

on_unlock.greeting_instruction: Len should arrive defensive, confused, and eager to leave before anyone examines the stopped watch.

len_talver.greeting: A courier steps off the train with a stopped watch.

full_character.name: Len Talver
full_character.personality_description: A sharp, defensive courier who covers fear with jokes and refuses to be treated like a helpless victim.
full_character.speech_style: Fast, sarcastic, and evasive until someone catches a real contradiction.

clothing.other_accessory: stopped wristwatch with two second hands

durable_known_facts: Len arrives on the 1:13 train after the announcement wire is traced.
Their watch stopped at a time that has not happened yet tonight.
They know a delivery address that is not on any current map.
They resist authority but respond to honest bargaining.
Their route gives the player a choice between preventing a dangerous boarding and learning a stronger clue.

clothing.other_accessory: stopped wristwatch with two second hands

mira_sorn.name: Mira Sorn
mira_sorn.meet_condition: Introduced after the lost-property room proves the pattern repeats.

on_unlock.greeting_instruction: Mira should enter quietly with an old transit map and act like she knows which questions are dangerous.

mira_sorn.greeting: A woman in a raincoat waits by the closed ticket gates.

full_character.name: Mira Sorn
full_character.personality_description: Quiet, composed, and hard to read. She speaks as if she has visited impossible platforms before and has learned which truths make people disappear.
full_character.speech_style: Soft, precise, and indirect, with warnings phrased as ordinary travel advice.
durable_known_facts: Mira appears after the lost-property room reveals evidence of repeated impossible arrivals.
She knows the phrase 'Neverline' but avoids saying who taught it to her.
She can guide the player toward the maintenance door if trusted.
She may be a survivor, a witness, or someone protecting the station from worse exposure.
Her advice is useful but incomplete, forcing the player to decide whether to trust her.

clothing.other_accessory: old transit map folded into a triangle

story_rules.text: Treat impossible train events as concrete evidence with physical traces, witnesses, records, and consequences; avoid dream logic unless a clue supports it.

world_notes: Orison Station normally has three platforms, a night desk, a public announcement booth, a lost-property room, and an old locked signal room.
The Neverline is not known to the public at the start; it is discovered through tickets, records, passengers, and station architecture.
unresolved_threads: Why did Platform Four appear tonight?
Who erased the old lower station from the public record?
Can stranded passengers return safely without hiding the truth again?
rules_and_constraints: The story should advance through investigation, evidence, and witness accounts.
Do not turn the station into a sentient building or a broad cosmic system; keep the focus on the local mystery.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The last scheduled train left Orison Station twenty minutes ago.

You are behind the night desk with the ledger open, the radio quiet, and Veda Coll pulling on her coat near the staff door.

The ticket printer clicks once.

A single blue ticket slides out by itself: Platform Four. Neverline. Due now.

Orison Station has three platforms.
